title: The Innovation Show (Aidan McCullen) — Eric on the governance fortress Sears, Toys R Us, and Nokia never built
summary: Aidan McCullen — Thinkers50 Award winner, host of the long-running Innovation Show — runs an Incorruptible episode framing the book through the Sears/Toys R Us/Nokia collapses as cautionary tales of mission drift driven by the Drama Triangle of investor 'rescuers' and management's mistaken trust.
blockquote: This week on The Innovation Show, Eric Ries walks through how to build the governance fortress that Sears, Toys R Us, and Nokia never had. Nokia, to their credit, eventually built one. The other two were devoured by the cats.
attribution_title: Podcast hosted by Aidan McCullen — Thinkers50 Award winner, keynote speaker on innovation and change
